Validation: The portable fixtures verify exact-link apply and rollback, legacy handling, and the bounded exposure summary. The Windows Drivers selector passes with the retired rule absent and fails once when its name is inserted into an inert helper. The applied NUC canary verified four directional echo series at 12/12 and a successful scripted rollback before the final application. The follow-up checks inspect both links without changing their receipts.
